_doc: Real products only. A non-null price must have been seen on that product page, with price_source (the exact URL and method) and price_seen_at. Every item url must be a real product page for that exact item, not a search, category, hub or landing page. Re-add removed items from data/notes/removed-rows.json when a verified product URL exists.
